mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_grant_batch WHERE actor_user_id=#{actor} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT FROM sys_grant_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{batch} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT FROM sys_grant_batch WHERE id=#{id} AND processing_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT FROM sys_grant_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{batch} AND processing_status='PENDING' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM sys_grant_batch WHERE id>#{after} AND processing_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_grant_batch_item SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND processing_status='PENDING' AND attempts<4
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_grant_batch_item WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_grant_batch_item SET processing_status='APPLIED',grant_source_id=#{source},result_code='OK', result_data=#{data} WHERE id=#{id} AND processing_status='PENDING'
UPDATE sys_grant_batch_item SET processing_status='FAILED',result_code=#{code} WHERE id=#{id} AND processing_status='PENDING'
UPDATE sys_grant_batch SET processing_status='PROCESSING' WHERE id=#{id} AND processing_status='PENDING'

UPDATE sys_grant_batch b JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, SUM(processing_status='PENDING') pending, SUM(processing_status='APPLIED') succeeded, SUM(processing_status='FAILED') failed FROM sys_grant_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{id} GROUP BY batch_id ) i ON b.id=i.batch_id SET b.processing_status=CASE WHEN i.pending>0 THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN i.failed=0 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN i.succeeded=0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' END WHERE b.id=#{id}
